title: Favard length and generalized projections
summary: We investigate generalized Favard lengths associated to smooth families of nonlinear projections. Under suitable regularity and transversality assumptions, we prove that generalized projections are locally comparable to orthogonal projections on sufficiently small scales. This yields a comparison principle that transfers quantitative upper bounds for classical Favard length to broad classes of nonlinear projection families.
